incidents.title: web-checkout 5xx spike
incidents.description: Sudden 5xx error rate surge on hosted payment element during peak checkout. Upstream auth-gateway reporting token verification latencies exceeding 2500ms.
incidents.suspected_cause: Session token verification failure cascade across auth-gateway and session-store.

incidents.title: notifications delivery failures
incidents.description: Outbound 2FA and transactional receipt SMS drops exceeding 35%. Downstream carrier gateway returning HTTP 429 and intermittent connection resets.
incidents.suspected_cause: Single upstream SMS aggregator rate limiting during marketing campaign burst. Prior decision DEC-028 called for secondary provider failover.
